purpose: Canonical research-layer borehole controls for future spatial lithology ensemble interpretation.
scientific_rules: Observed depth point is not automatically a lithological interval.
Projected sections are not borehole logs.
Regional structural models are not boreholes.
Approximate coordinates may be used for interpolation with reduced spatial weight.
Approximate coordinates must not be displayed publicly as exact borehole locations.
Formation thickness is not depth below ground.

coordinate_policy.recorded_coordinates: May be displayed only when source precision is defensible.
coordinate_policy.approximate_coordinates: May participate in interpolation after location assignment and uncertainty estimation, but display_on_map remains false.
coordinate_policy.next_step: Assign approximate coordinates and uncertainty in batches using site, profile, settlement and source descriptions.
coordinate_policy.radiana_note: BH1-BH12 use official EIA Table 3.2-9 source coordinates. The printed coordinate pair was spatially validated as BGS1970 K3; transformation library input uses [printed Y, printed X].
coordinate_policy.marichin_note: Six boreholes normalized by evidence role. Coordinates remain unresolved. No arbitrary site centroid or uncertainty value assigned.

documented_intervals.material: Clays with sand seams and marls
